fusions.name: Venom Wrung Out
fusions.desc: Only strikes a target at or below 25% health, and that threshold rises with each rank. You squeeze it for 20 damage and wring out every affliction on it, adding 1.5 times the damage they had left to deal.

fusions.name: Bilious Bellow
fusions.desc: Bellows a cone of bile 4 tiles long, dealing 12 damage to everything in it and knocking it back 2.5 tiles. Each hit has a 60% chance to leave the target [Poisoned] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Sweat It Out
fusions.desc: Removes up to 2 poison conditions from you and restores 12 health.

fusions.name: Bitter Hide
fusions.desc: Each affliction laid on you has a 20% chance to be sent back to whoever laid it.
